sections.heading: Display Support
sections.source_text:
M5 Max
Supports up to five external displays over any combination of Thunderbolt and HDMI ports:
Five displays: Four displays up to a native resolution of 6K at 60Hz or 4K at 165Hz, plus a fifth display with up to 5K at 60Hz over HDMI
Up to three displays: Two displays up to a native resolution of 8K at 60Hz or 5K at 120Hz or 4K at 240Hz, plus a third display with up to 5K at 60Hz over HDMI
Supports up to four external displays over a single Thunderbolt port
Thunderbolt 5 (USB‑C) ports support native DisplayPort 2.1 speeds
Supports variable refresh rate (VRR), HDR and multi‑channel audio
M5 Ultra
Supports up to eight external displays over any combination of Thunderbolt and HDMI ports:
Eight displays up to a native resolution of 6K at 60Hz or 4K resolution at up to 165Hz
Up to four displays up to a native resolution of 8K at 60Hz or 5K at 120Hz or 4K at 240Hz
Supports up to four external displays over a single Thunderbolt port
Thunderbolt 5 (USB‑C) ports support native DisplayPort 2.1 speeds
Supports variable refresh rate (VRR), HDR and multi‑channel audio
Learn more about connecting a display to your Mac

sections.heading: Mac Studio and the Environment
sections.source_text:
See the Mac Studio Product Environmental Report (PDF)
Progress towards Apple 2030
Apple 2030 is our goal to be carbon neutral across our value chain. We design our products to be less carbon intensive by prioritising the use of recycled and renewable content and low-carbon materials while focusing on the energy efficiency of our software and hardware.
See Apple’s commitment
Materials
Mac Studio is made with 35% recycled content,
7
including:
100% recycled aluminium in the enclosure and thermal module sheet, chassis and brackets
100% recycled copper in the thermal module pedestal and multiple printed circuit boards
100% recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple‑designed printed circuit boards
90% recycled steel in multiple thermal module components
Packaging
100% fibre-based packaging
8
Energy
ENERGY STAR® certified
9
Smarter chemistry
10
All the materials used in Apple products, accessories and packaging are covered by the requirements of our
Regulated Substances Specification
, which was one of the first in industry to restrict the use of key substances of concern. See the latest
Environmental Progress Report
to understand Apple’s recent efforts in phasing out these chemistries.
